paragraphs.zh: (1)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (1) Preparation of a 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:
paragraphs.notes: 苯甲酸盐 is the salt of the acid; the counter-ion is not named here and only appears in the drawing (K) and in [0134].
This marker carries no prose. Its content is the drawn reaction scheme recorded as drawings[0].

paragraphs.zh: 向反应瓶中加入叔戊醇50mL和叔丁醇150mL，开动搅拌，室温下将14.0g氢化钾(30％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待氢化钾溶解完全后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应6h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐归一含量为98.2％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
paragraphs.en: Into the reaction flask were added 50 mL of tert-amyl alcohol and 150 mL of tert-butanol; stirring was started, and at room temperature 14.0 g of potassium hydride (30％, 0.105 mol) was added dropwise into it. After the potassium hydride had dissolved completely, the vessel temperature was controlled at 25℃, and 34.8 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate (98％, 0.1 mol) was poured into the vessel to carry out the alkaline hydrolysis reaction. The reaction was slightly exothermic; the vessel temperature was controlled at 25℃ and the reaction ran for 6 h. After the reaction ended, in-process liquid chromatography gave a normalised content of 98.2％ for potassium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate. The solvent was stripped off completely under reduced pressure and the material was used directly in the subsequent etherification reaction.
paragraphs.notes: 氢化钾 is potassium hydride, and it is stated as "30％" and added "dropwise" (滴入), which reads oddly for a solid hydride; transcribed literally without interpretation. 归一含量 = area-normalised (HPLC/LC) content.

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:

paragraphs.notes: This marker carries no prose. Its content is the drawn reaction scheme recorded as drawings[1].

paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入200mL DMF、13.6g三氟乙醇(99％，0.135mol)和9.9g氢氧化钾(85％，0.15mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应5h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.5g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为97.1％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率91.1％。
paragraphs.en: Into the reaction vessel were added 200 mL of DMF, 13.6 g of trifluoroethanol (99％, 0.135 mol) and 9.9 g of potassium hydroxide (85％, 0.15 mol); stirring was started and the vessel temperature was controlled at 5℃. The potassium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate obtained in step (1) (98.2％, 0.1 mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, the total addition time being 3 h; after addition was complete the reaction was held at temperature for 5 h. When the reaction was complete, the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120 mL of water was added to the vessel residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3. Then filtration, water rinsing and drying gave 32.5 g of product; HPLC assay gave a content of 97.1％ of the target compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, a two-step reaction yield of 91.1％ based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: 三氟乙醇 here is 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol. The text says the potassium salt was added "to the reaction flask" (反应瓶) although the charge was made to a 反应釜 (vessel/reactor) in the same sentence; transcribed as printed.

paragraphs.zh: (1)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (1) Preparation of a 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:
paragraphs.notes: Same wording as [0132]; here the counter-ion in the drawing and in [0141] is sodium.
This marker carries no prose. Its content is the drawn reaction scheme recorded as drawings[2].

paragraphs.zh: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇200mL，开动搅拌，室温下将2.4g金属钠(99％，0.105mol)加入其中，待金属钠溶解完全后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应6h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐归一含量为98.3％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
paragraphs.en: Into the reaction flask was added 200 mL of tert-butanol; stirring was started, and at room temperature 2.4 g of sodium metal (99％, 0.105 mol) was added into it. After the sodium metal had dissolved completely, the vessel temperature was controlled at 25℃, and 34.8 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate (98％, 0.1 mol) was poured into the vessel to carry out the alkaline hydrolysis reaction. The reaction was slightly exothermic; the vessel temperature was controlled at 25℃ and the reaction ran for 6 h. After the reaction ended, in-process liquid chromatography gave a normalised content of 98.3％ for sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate. The solvent was stripped off completely under reduced pressure and the material was used directly in the subsequent etherification reaction.
paragraphs.notes: Sodium metal in tert-butanol forms sodium tert-butoxide in situ; the text states only that the sodium dissolved.

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:
paragraphs.notes: The reaction equation this sentence announces is not on this page; it continues on the next page.

drawings.notes: The product carboxylate is drawn as a covalent K-O bond (label "KO" on the carbonyl carbon), not as separated ions; the SMILES is given in the ionic form the salt name implies, and this is the only interpretive step taken. Nothing is written below the arrow. The methyl ester is drawn as a bare line from the ester oxygen (implicit CH3).

Above and below the arrow are distinct: the etherification reagents CF3CH2OH and KOH (separated by the enumeration mark 、) are above, and HCl (the acidification of the workup, [0137]) is below. The side chain of the product is drawn as ring-CH2-O-CH2-CF3, with the terminal group labelled CF3 and the ether oxygen shown explicitly as O.

Identical to drawings[0] except that the reagent above the arrow is Na and the product is drawn as the sodium salt (label "NaO" on the carbonyl carbon, again as a covalent Na-O bond). Nothing below the arrow.

discrepancies.what: The solvents of step (1) of the first example are in the prose but nowhere in the scheme.
discrepancies.text_says: [0134] charges 叔戊醇50mL (50 mL tert-amyl alcohol) and 叔丁醇150mL (150 mL tert-butanol) as the reaction medium.

discrepancies.what: The solvent of the etherification is in the prose but not in the scheme.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Above the arrow only CF3CH2OH and KOH; below only HCl.

discrepancies.what: The scheme shows HCl as a reagent below the arrow, whereas the prose has it only as a pH adjustment in the workup.
discrepancies.drawing_says: HCl written below the etherification arrow.
discrepancies.text_says: [0137] adds 浓盐酸 (concentrated hydrochloric acid) after solvent stripping to acidify the system to pH 3, i.e. workup, not a reagent of the etherification.

discrepancies.what: The solvent of step (1) of Example 11 is in the prose but not in the scheme.
The trifluoroethanol reagent is written with a different level of detail in the drawing and the text.
discrepancies.text_says: [0137] 三氟乙醇 (trifluoroethanol), unqualified by position; the product name in [0135] and [0137] confirms the 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy group.

discrepancies.what: The alkali metal salts are drawn with a covalent metal-oxygen bond rather than as ionic carboxylates.
discrepancies.drawing_says: KO-C(=O)- and NaO-C(=O)- drawn as ordinary single bonds.
discrepancies.text_says: [0134] and [0141] name the products 钾盐 and 钠盐 (potassium salt, sodium salt).
